def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    original_loan_amount = 15000
    monthly_payment = 700
    original_payments = 24
    payments_made = 10
    remaining_payments = original_payments - payments_made

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    total_finance_charge = (
        original_payments * monthly_payment
    ) - original_loan_amount

    unearned_interest = total_finance_charge * (
        remaining_payments * (remaining_payments + 1)
    ) / (
        original_payments * (original_payments + 1)
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(unearned_interest)
